summary: Iteration 6 (bug-fix) verified end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — POST /api/shopping/clear-checked now hard-deletes ALL checked items regardless of source (manual-only, planner-only, mixed planner+manual). Planner slot rows are NOT modified. Unchecked items are untouched. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, fresh register): (1) new empty planner slot displays persons-count = '1' (was 2); code review confirms currentPersons from route params still hydrates when editing an existing slot. (2) new dish editor testID='dish-servings' input defaults to '1' (was 2). (3) Spesa full flow works: add manual item → check → tap 'Rimuovi presi' (testID='clear-checked') → item disappears from list. No red-screen, no deprecated Expo packages introduced. One React 19 warning surfaced ('Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19') but it is unrelated to iteration 6 changes and non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional: pre-existing console warning 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' is emitted by an upstream library / component (not touched by iteration 6). Not blocking, but worth investigating in a future maintenance pass to avoid noise.
seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh throwaway account (test<timestamp>@t.co / test1234) per flow. Backend tests create their own isolated users via /api/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 fixes are stable. clear-checked endpoint at POST /api/shopping/clear-checked is now a hard-delete for any row where checked=true; the planner slot rows remain untouched (only shopping_items are affected). Frontend default quantities: planner-slot persons_count and DishEditor servings both default to '1' for the new-item flow. To hit the planner-slot screen from tests, from the planner tab click any testID='slot-<i>-<meal>' cell — that navigates to /planner-slot. tab bar labels are Piatti/Planner/Spesa (no testIDs on the tab bar itself; use get_by_text).
